title: Smart Contract Security Audit: cultivar_v1.sol
description: The security audit of the Cultivar smart contract revealed significant issues including a lack of reentrancy protection in critical functions related to Ethereum transfers and inadequate validation of Chainlink oracle data. The contract is deemed to have high risks due to these vulnerabilities that may impact financial operations. Additional concerns arise from centralization risks associated with owner privileges over key contract features.
